title: genista tricuspidata subsp. duriaei
intro: Genista tricuspidata subsp. duriaei, commonly known as French broom, is a flowering plant in the pea family Fabaceae. It is a deciduous shrub native to the Iberian Peninsula and southwestern France, valued for its health benefits and therapeutic properties. Genista tricuspidata subsp. duriaei has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including inflammatory and cardiovascular diseases, due to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The plant contains bioactive constituents like flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to fully understand its health benefits and therapeutic potential.
